The Critical Systems Administrator – BMS/BAS & Video Management is the technical owner for the company’s building management, building automation, and video-management systems, including security camera infrastructure, across all data center locations.

description:

Lightedge is seeking an Investments Associate to lead the review of site acquisitions and development projects. The Investments Associate reports to Vice President of Strategic Finance and plays a key role in Lightedge’s five-year plan to deliver 20MW of IT capacity per year across the portfolio. This role owns the financial modeling and underwriting behind new sites and expansions and prepares the investment materials for senior management and the Board of Directors.
Responsibilities
Lead the review of site acquisitions and development projects in support of Lightedge’s five-year plan to deliver 20MW of IT capacity per year across the portfolio
Work with internal stakeholders and third parties to qualify and disqualify potential acquisitions and development projects
Lead financial modeling and underwriting for land and asset acquisitions, greenfield development and in-place capacity expansions
Build and maintain project-level and consolidated return models, including IRR, NPV and yield-on-cost, with sensitivity and scenario analysis on power, cost, timing and absorption
Review and own project budgets from initial underwriting through construction completion, tracking committed spend, actuals and forecast-to-complete against approved capital
Create investment memos for board approval of projects, including transaction summary, market analysis, underwriting assumptions, returns, key risks and mitigants
Build and maintain relationships with brokers in target markets to generate a steady pipeline of site acquisition and development opportunities
Support monthly and quarterly board reporting on the development pipeline, capital deployment and project performance versus underwriting
Coordinate due diligence with engineering, facilities, sales, legal and third-party consultants
Evaluate power availability and utility economics, land basis, entitlements, construction cost and incentive packages as inputs to site selection
Research and report on data center market supply, absorption and comparable transactions to expand market knowledge and support pipeline development

Education And Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or equivalent is required
5+ years of experience in real estate or infrastructure investments, investment banking, private equity or corporate development
Advanced financial modeling skills, including building project-level and consolidated models from scratch and applying IRR and ROI analysis
Experience underwriting development or capital projects and owning capital budgets; data center, industrial or other capital-intensive real asset experience preferred
Ability to analyze and interpret property-level information
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare board- and executive-level materials that present complex analysis clearly and concisely
Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
Extensive experience in working with large data sets and financial modeling
Ability to meet deadlines, handle multiple priorities and perform job responsibilities while working in a fast-paced and vibrant environment
Self-starter attitude with strong interpersonal skills and teamwork ability
Extensive experience working with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

description:

Manager of Operations Training
Work Location: Austin / Des Moines / Kansas City
POSITION SUMMARY
Lightedge is seeking a Manager of Operations Training to lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of training programs for technical Operations teams. This role owns onboarding, continuing education, technical documentation, skills assessment, Learning Management System administration, and the development of consistent training practices across the organization.
The Manager of Operations Training leads and develops Technical Trainers, Technical Writers, and other training contributors. This position establishes priorities, manages training capacity and performance, coaches team members, and partners with Operations, Engineering, Product, People, and other stakeholders to align training with process changes, technology updates, service requirements, and business priorities.
The ideal candidate can translate complex technical and operational processes into clear, practical learning experiences while using data, feedback, and responsible AI practices to improve employee performance and operational outcomes.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Training Strategy and Delivery
Own onboarding and continuing-education programs for Operations teams, from needs analysis through delivery and evaluation.
Design and facilitate technical training, workshops, refresher courses, and hands-on learning experiences.
Create and maintain technical documentation and curricula, including knowledgebase articles, training videos, instructor guides, and live training templates.
Assess individual and team skill gaps and develop targeted training plans and career development resources.
Build standardized training frameworks, learning paths, assessments, and qualification programs.
Maintain a consistent training experience across teams, locations, schedules, and operational functions.
Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including courses, enrollments, learning paths, permissions, reporting, and content publishing.
Leadership and Team Management
Lead, coach, and develop Technical Trainers, Technical Writers, and other training contributors.
Establish team goals, performance expectations, delivery standards, and quality measures.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, team meetings, performance discussions, and development conversations.
Provide ongoing feedback, recognition, coaching, and accountability to support individual and team success.
Manage training workload, capacity planning, project assignments, and delivery priorities.
Coordinate training calendars, facilitator assignments, curriculum development, and content-production schedules.
Identify skill gaps within the training team and create opportunities for professional growth and cross-training.
Participate in recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and succession planning for training team members.
Lead Technical Trainer and Technical Writer work using Agile/Scrum practices and clearly defined goals.
Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture across the training organization.
Operational Partnership and Continuous Improvement
Partner with technical and business stakeholders to keep training aligned with process changes, technology updates, operational requirements, and customer-impact priorities.
Lead regular planning, status, and tactical meetings to review training priorities, open deliverables, risks, dependencies, and performance.
Gather feedback from learners, instructors, managers, and stakeholders to improve training effectiveness.
Track training completion, assessment results, time to productivity, content quality, and other performance indicators.
Use training and operational data to identify trends, recommend improvements, and measure program effectiveness.
Maintain PHP-based training or operational applications when assigned, including troubleshooting, configuration, content or code updates, testing, and release coordination.
Use AI tools responsibly for content creation, instructional frameworks, assessments, scenario development, feedback analysis, and quality improvement with appropriate human review.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Experience designing and delivering technical training for IT operations, infrastructure, engineering, or comparable technical teams.
Experience leading, coaching, or managing trainers, technical writers, instructional designers, or other learning professionals.
Experience establishing team goals, managing workloads, conducting performance discussions, and developing employees.
Experience with instructional design, training needs analysis, skills gap assessment, and learning evaluation.
Strong presentation, facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to explain complex technical and non-technical processes clearly to varied audiences.
Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, knowledge articles, training videos, curriculum, instructor guides, or similar learning content.
Experience administering and maintaining an LMS, including course setup, enrollments, permissions, reporting, learning paths, and content publishing.
Experience with knowledge management, workflow, project management, or learning platforms.
Demonstrated technical Operations experience and an understanding of technical problem resolution.
Experience using generative AI tools to support training content creation, evaluation, instructional design, or feedback analysis with sound judgment and human review.
A degree or formal certification in instructional design, education, business, information technology, or a related field is preferred; equivalent experience is welcome.
PREFERRED SKILLS
Instructional design and technical facilitation
Training team leadership and employee development
Learning measurement and performance improvement
Learning Management Systems
Knowledge-management platforms
ServiceNow and related workflow platforms
Agile/Scrum practices
ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable generative AI tools
PHP and web development

Product Marketing Manager
Position Summary
We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bring our private, hybrid cloud and emerging technology offerings, including our AI infrastructure solutions, to market. You'll shape how we position and launch these offerings, help Sales win and grow accounts, and support our relationship with Gartner. Product Management owns what we build. You'll own how we tell the story and how we drive adoption and revenue growth in the market.
Key Responsibilities
Go-to-Market and Launches
Plan and run go-to-market for products and services, with clear adoption and revenue goals for each.
Develop positioning, messaging, and value propositions that clearly show the business value of our solutions.
Create sales tools, collateral, customer stories, and content that support demand generation and adoption.
Revenue Growth and Solution Penetration
Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success on campaigns and plays that increase pipeline and expand solution adoption across our customer base.
Track and report on marketing's contribution to revenue, including pipeline, win rates, and cross-sell and upsell results.
Provide market and competitive input to support Product Management's pricing and packaging decisions.
Analyst Relations
Support our relationship with Gartner and other analysts, including briefings, inquiries, and report submissions such as Magic Quadrants and Market Guides.
Put analyst insights and recognition to work in our messaging and sales programs.
Market and Customer Insight
Research market trends, buyer needs, and competitors across private cloud, hybrid infrastructure, and AI.
Share customer and market feedback with Product Management to inform their roadmap decisions.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
5+ years of product marketing experience in B2B technology.
Required: Experience marketing VMware, IBM, or Nutanix solutions, either directly or through a partner, reseller, or MSP.
Practical understanding of AI and how businesses are using it today.
Experience connecting marketing programs to pipeline and revenue results.
Strong writing, presentation, and storytelling skills.
Collaborative and organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience working with Gartner or other industry analysts, or in the MSP or ITSM space, is a plus.
